summary: Iteration 5: Static AST/py_compile verification of the Cloud Run gateway (/app/gateway/server.py) plus regression tests on the serving Emergent FastAPI backend. All 11 pytest tests passed (7 static + 4 regression). Gateway code correctly replaces the broken `.query()` call with `create_session`/`get_session` + `stream_query`, wraps events via `_to_jsonable`, extracts session id via `_session_id`, and returns `{session_id, events}`. Both `/agent` (sync) and `/vision` (async) endpoints call `_query`. Serving backend golden path (/api/agent/health, /api/partner/health, /api/auth/me with Bearer e2e_1788105676, POST /api/experiences + POST /api/experiences/{id}/plan) all return 200; plan.title is bilingual (en/es) and missions list is non-empty.
critical_code_review_comments: gateway/server.py: `_query` is synchronous and iterates `stream_query` — acceptable for Cloud Run; consider `async_stream_query` if endpoint becomes async in future.
gateway/server.py: `_to_jsonable` uses `json.dumps` with `default=` — safe fallback. Good.
gateway/server.py: `run_agent` is sync but `_query` performs blocking network I/O — under FastAPI it will run in threadpool, OK for now but consider making it async for higher concurrency.

gateway/server.py imports env vars at module top (GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, VERTEX_AGENT_ENGINE_ID) causing KeyError at import if missing — appropriate fail-fast for Cloud Run but blocks any static import outside GCP (confirmed).
test_credentials: Bearer e2e_1788105676 (from review_request, verified working against /api/auth/me).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral experience 'TEST_LUMIERE regression' via POST /api/experiences during regression test; no cleanup performed (record left in DB with TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: gateway/server.py cannot be imported in this environment (requires GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT + VERTEX_AGENT_ENGINE_ID + live ADC). Use AST/py_compile static verification only. Serving backend does NOT import gateway/ — regression path is stable. /plan endpoint requires body {"intent": "..."} and returns {plan:{title:{en,es}, missions:[...]}, missions:{missions:[...]}, context:{...}}. Gemini call takes ~20s so use timeout>=30s.
rca of the issue: Root cause of production error `agent_engine_error: 'AgentEngine' object has no attribute 'query'`: google-cloud-aiplatform 1.165.1's AgentEngine surface removed `.query()`; only stream_query/async_stream_query/create_session/get_session/list_sessions exist. Mitigation applied in /app/gateway/server.py _query(): (1) resolve/create session first (session_id must exist in engine), (2) iterate a.stream_query(user_id, session_id, message) and coerce each event via _to_jsonable(), (3) return JSON-serializable {session_id, events}. Both /agent and /vision now go through the same fixed helper. Verified statically via AST — cannot run gateway here (no GCP creds), but code shape matches SDK contract.
